name: fam-01-write
prompt: Add ResetPassword(userID string) error to Store in session.go: delete every session whose User matches userID (no per-user index, so scan) and return nil, or ErrNotFound when none match. Wire it nowhere else; the method is the deliverable.
check:
grep -F -q 'func (s *Store) ResetPassword' session.go || { echo 'precursor change missing' >&2; exit 1; }
go build ./... && go test -count=1 ./...
